namespaces.description: Build an npm package that adds components, templates, themes, docs, and codemods to Astryx apps, and look up every field of every file it holds.
Commands, programmatic APIs, and output contracts. Building an integration is under `astryx docs authoring`.
Color, elevation, icons, illustrations, motion, shape, and spacing: the visual foundations every component builds on. Each topic keeps its own name; open one by it.
Install Astryx once on your computer and use it in any folder. Each project still runs its own version of Astryx, so a global install never changes what a project gets.
Guides that stand on their own: getting started, principles, theming, and working with AI. Each topic keeps its own name; open one by it.
Set the active locale, load catalogs, coexist with your own i18n library, handle RTL, and test translations.
Build an app layout outside-in: scaffold the regions, structure the content, tune the spacing, then adapt across widths.
Migrate an existing Tailwind, shadcn, or Radix app to the design system incrementally — setup, component replacement, and verification.
Customize component appearance: xstyle, Tailwind, className, rest props, compound components, data attribute selectors, tokens, and StyleX setup.
Integrate Tailwind, StyleX, Panda, Chakra, MUI, CSS-in-JS, CSS Modules, and non-CSS renderers with system tokens.
Complete reference for color, data visualization, syntax, spacing, size, border, focus, radius, shadow, motion, and typography tokens.
Font families, geometric type scale, weight, line-height, and semantic text tokens for consistent, accessible text styling.
